basic.title: Download psi-full-runtime-mac.zip
basic.description: Download psi-full-runtime-mac.zip — it contains both RUNTIME and MODELS:
basic.noteBeforeImage: NOTE: Put it in a root folder using a short path with no accents and no special characters, to avoid permission errors. For example: ~/PSI

basic.title: Extract the ZIP file
basic.description: Right-click the downloaded .zip file and extract it to a folder. After extraction you should have two folders: RUNTIME/ (app and runtime) and MODELS/ (AI models, default is an empty folder).

basic.title: Open the app
basic.description: Open the RUNTIME folder, double-click AI Content Hub.app to run it, or right-click and choose "Open". The app is notarized by Apple and does not require extra steps.
basic.note: If you encounter Gatekeeper issues, open Terminal on Mac and run: `sudo xattr -r -d com.apple.quarantine /path/to/RUNTIME/AI\ Content\ Hub.app`. Replace /path/to/RUNTIME with the actual path to the RUNTIME folder ([1]). Then enter your password and try opening the app again.

noteLinks.text: Learn how to get the path

basic.title: Wait for the app to start
basic.description: The first startup may take a few minutes. If it takes longer than 10 minutes, go to the Settings page and start the app manually.

basic.title: Go to Settings to start the app
basic.description: Open the Settings page inside the app and click the start button to launch the app manually if needed.

basic.title: Download the models you need
basic.description: On the Settings page, press Download to fetch the models the server and each feature need. Models are saved into the MODELS folder.
basic.note: NOTE: Only download models for the features you actually use. Hover the ? next to a model name to see what the app uses it for. The app saves and detects models automatically in the right subfolder inside MODELS.

basic.title: After the models are downloaded
basic.description: Once a model is downloaded its status shows "Installed". Heavy models are not loaded into GPU/CPU straight away, to keep your machine light — they load the first time you use the feature. On a powerful machine you can press "Load into memory" beforehand so there is no wait later.
